frqDirections: Interactive Java Editor: Write a Java method or snippet below. In the macOS desktop app with JDK installed, click Run Java to compile and execute locally.

questions.stemHtml:
int sum = 0;
for (int k = 1; k <= 7; k += 2) {
    sum += k;
}
questions.promptHtml: What value is stored in sum after the loop finishes executing?

explanations.2: Indices start at 0 (`B`=0, `l`=1, `u`=2, `e`=3, `j`=4, `a`=5). substring(2, 5) takes indices 2, 3, and 4, yielding "uej".

frqQuestions.stemHtml: Complete the static method countAbove(int[] nums, int limit) so it returns how many elements in nums are strictly greater than limit.
frqQuestions.promptHtml: Implement countAbove using an enhanced for loop or indexed loop.
frqQuestions.rubricHtml:
• Initializes counter to 0 before loop.
  • Traverses every element of nums without out-of-bounds error.
  • Increments only when element is strictly > limit and returns the count.
